title: Build a RocketMQ workload and recovery envelope
description: Choose a workload, then change arrival rate, consumers, retention, and outage length. The model separates workload arithmetic from deployment-specific broker benchmarks.

workloads.label: Order events
workloads.detail: Moderate payloads with per-order sequencing and several independent downstream consumer groups.

workloads.label: Device telemetry
workloads.detail: Many small measurements where batch efficiency and filtering shape consumer throughput.

workloads.label: Settlement commands
workloads.detail: Larger commands with expensive downstream checks and a lower measured service rate per consumer.
